ios.desc:
Embark on a whimsical journey with Flying Toasters, the ultimate (and only) Screen Saver for Apple Vision Pro. Immerse yourself in an otherworldly adventure with customizable flying toasters, enchanting cosmic portals, and engaging interactivity. Perfect for both productivity boosts and moments of relaxation, this app transforms your environment into a mesmerizing dreamscape.

Features:

Cosmic Portals: Craft your celestial scene with movable portals against a vibrant starfield backdrop, linking the sun to the moon.
Toaster Customization: Tailor the spectacle with adjustable toaster counts and colors, plus toastiness levels for your toasts.
Engaging Interactivity: Discover quirky toaster tales with a simple tap on the toasters.
Timer: Set your desired countdown time to kick-off the Screen Saver. Reset the countdown by periodically tapping an image of two Flying Toasters on the main control screen.
Volumetric display mode: Run the Screen Saver within its own 2x2x2 box alongside other apps.

Elevate your Apple Vision Pro experience with a touch of nostalgia and a dash of cosmic wonder.
